title: Did the Reflexion lessons help?
description: Compare extraction exact-match rates on development check-split cases before and after frozen playbook 1.0.0. Include lesson-generation cost and any regressing case. Held-out extraction cases remain Role-5-only and are not in this repo.

approved_lessons.summary: Excluded groups must be written as fact eq false, not true.

development_result: eval/reports/e3_before_after_dev_2026-11-13.json: development check split, 6 cases x3 repeats. Raw exact 9/18 without a playbook, 18/18 with playbook 1.0.0; cases passing all runs 3/6 to 6/6; 0 regressions; 36 model calls, 0 USD (free model). Directional, not held-out.
blocker: A protected held-out extraction set (Role 5) is still required for the final E3 claim.
